msContents.summary: This is a paper manuscript of the Itihāsasamuccaya. According to the catalogue entry, it belongs to the Mirikar collection of the Bharat Itihasa Samsodhan Mandal.

msItem.title: Itihāsasamuccaya
msItem.finalRubric:
itihāsasamuccaye saṃsārakūpavarṇanaṃ nā
ma || itihāsasamuccayaḥ samāptaḥ ||
msItem.colophon:
atha saṃvatsare smin śrīnṛpativikramādityarājye || saṃvat
|| 1778 varṣe māhavadīmāvaśyāṃ 15 śanavāsare liṣitaṃ subham astu || aparaṃ pustakaṃ vakṣe śo
dhinīyaṃ sadā budhaiḥ || hīnādhikyair surair varṇair asmākaṃ dūṣaṇaṃ na hi || subham astu leṣakapāṭhakayoḥ ||

lg.l:
kathayaṃtaṃ hi tīrthānāṃ prabhāvānn adbhutāṃs
tathā ||
lokasaṃ sarvatatvajñaṃ paryavṛchat_ yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ||
yo rakṣet prāṇinaṃ brahman_ bhayārttaṃ śaraṇāgataṃ ||

ta
sya puṇyaphalaṃ yat syāt_ tan me brūhi tapodhana 2
ekataḥ kratavaḥ sarve samagrā caiva dakṣiṇā

ekato bhayabhī
tasya prāṇinaṃ prāṇarakṣaṇaṃ 3
idam eva purā devaiḥ tulayā samatolayat
prāṇarakṣaṇam eveha gauraveṇātiricyate 4
athaivodāharaṃtīmam itihāsaṃ purātanaṃ
idrasyāgneś ca saṃvādaṃ śiver auśīnarasya ca 5

varttamāne mahāyajñe jijñāsārthaṃ śi
viṃ nṛpaṃ
idraḥ śyena kapoto gnir bhūtvā tatropajagmatuḥ 6
athoruṃ nṛpateḥ prāpya kapota śyenajād bhayāt

śaraṇārthaṃ mahīpā
laṃ nililye bhayavihvalaḥ 7
tataḥ śanair upāgamyā śyenarūpisureśvaraḥ
rājānaṃ sa mahātmānaṃ provācedaṃ vacas tathā 8
dharmātmānaṃ tvam ity āhur ekaṃ rājan mahīkṣitām
sa ca dharmavirudhaṃ hi kathaṃ karma cikīrṣasi 9

bhavāṃ tatasa
dānena satyenānṛtavādiṣu
kṣamayā krūrakarmāṇam asādhuṃ sādhu juhya tu 10
nopakāraparo py evam upakāraparo janaḥ

apakā
raparo nityaṃ upakāraparo yathā 11
ahite hitabuddhis tvaṃ pāpe vatav apāpakṛt

doṣānveṣaṇaddakṣe pi guṇānveṣaṇata
tparaḥ 12
tad evaṃ vihito bhakṣapīḍyamānasya me kṣudhā
mā hiṃse lobhato dharmmaṃ dharmam utsṛṣṭavān asi 13

saṃ
trastas tava trāṇārthī tvato bhito vihaṃgamaḥ
matsakāśam anuprāptaḥ prāṇān_ gṛhṇurayāṃ khagaḥ 14

tad evam āgatasyāsya
kapotasyābhayārdditaḥ
katham asmadvidho kuryus tyāgaṃ sadbhir vigarhitaṃ 15

lobhāt_ dviṣād bhayād vāpi yastyajecharaṇāga
taṃ
brahmahatyāsamaṃ tasya pāpam āhur manīṣiṇaḥ || 16
śāstreṣu niṣkṛtiṃ dṛṣṭvā mahāpātakinām api

śaraṇāgatahaṃtus tu na dṛṣṭvā ni
ṣkṛtiḥ kvacit 17
yathātmanaṃ priyā prāṇā sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ tathā
tasmān mṛtyubhayatrastās trātavyā prāṇino budhaiḥ 18

janmamṛ
tyujarāduḥkhair nnityaṃ saṃsārasāgare
jaṃtavaḥ parikliśyaṃte mṛtyo trasyaṃti te tatha 19

yannimittaṃ bhave chokas trāśo vā krodha
eva ca
āyāso vā yato mūlam ekāṃgatami api saṃtyajet 20
marīkṣakṣyāmi taṃ duḥkhaṃ puruṣasyopajāyate ||

yuktaṃ tenānumānena
paro pi parirakṣyate 21
yathā hi te jīvitam ātmano priyaṃ tathā pareṣāṃm api jīvita priyaṃ

sa rakṣyate jīvitam ātmano yathā ta
thā pareṣām api rakṣya jīvitaṃ 22
tavasmāt tavam imaṃ bhītam rakṣayiṣye kapotakaṃ
yad atra yuktaṃ manyaṃte karttuṃ śyenāśu tad vadaḥ 23
āhāre sarvabhūtāni saṃbhavaṃti nareśvaraḥ
āhāreṇa vivarddhaṃte na ca jīvaṃti jaṃtavaḥ 24

śakyaṃte na vināhāro rājan_
varddhayitvaṃ ciraṃ
śakyaṃte duṣkare py arthe cirarātreṇa jīvitaṃ 25
nārthair anyai vināhāraṃ jīvitaṃ kasyacid bhavet

na tv āhāravihīnena
śakyaṃ varttaitvaṃ ciraṃ 26
bhartā vilopitaṃ yāsye mama prāṇān_ viśāṃ pate
mṛte ca mayi sarve me putradārā mariṣyati 27

ra
kṣamāṇakapotaṃ tvaṃ bahūn_ prāṇān_ haniṣyasi
dharmaṃ yo bādhate dharmo na mataḥ satāṃ 28

avirodhī tu yo dharmmavinirṇayaṃ sa
dharmmaḥ sadbhir ucyate
tasmād virodhe dharmmasya saṃciṃtya gurulāghavaṃ 29
yato bhūyās tato rājan_ kuru dharmmavinirṇayaṃ 30
nāto bhūyataro dharmo kaścid anyo sti khecara
prāṇināṃ bhayabhītānām abhayaṃ yat pradīyate 31

varam ekasya satva
sya datvā abhayadakṣiṇā
na tu viprasahasrasya gosahasram alaṃkṛtaṃ 32
abhayaṃ sarvabhūtebhyo yo dadāti dayāparaḥ

tasya de
hād vimuktasya na bhayaṃ vidyate kvacit 33
hemadhoenudharādīnāṃ dātāraḥ sulabhā bhuvi

durllabhaḥ puruṣo loke sarvabhūtā
bhayaprada 33
mahatām api yajñānāṃ kālena kṣīyate phalaṃ
bhītābhayapradānasya kṣaya eva na vidyate 34

dattam iṣṭaṃ tapa
s taptaṃ tīrthasevā śrutaṃ tathā
sarvāny abhayadānasya kalāṃ nārhaṃti ṣoḍaśī 35
catuḥsāgaraparyaṃtā yo dadyāt_ pṛthivīm imāṃ
abhayaṃ yaś ca bhūtebhyo tayor abhayado dhikaḥ 36
api styāje rājyam idaṃ śarīraṃ cāpi dustyajaṃ

na imaṃ bhayasaṃtrastaṃ tyaje dīnaṃ
kapotakaṃ 37
jan mamāsti śubhaṃ kiṃcit_ tena janmani janmani
bhaveyam aham ārtānāṃ prāṇināṃ ārttināśanaṃ 38

na hy a
haṃ kāmayed rājyaṃ na svargaṃ nāpunarbhavaṃ
prāṇināṃ bhayabhītānāṃ kāmayed bhayanāśanaṃ 39

yathā ca nānṛtā vāṇī mayaiṣā sa
mudāhṛtā
satyena tena bhagavan_ prasīdatu maheśvaraḥ 40
āhārārthe samāraṃbhās tava cāyaṃ vihaṃgama

tarhy artheṣṭaṃ yathā
hāram anyam eva dadāmy ahaṃ 41
sa eva vihito smākaṃ dhāttrā bhakṣyaḥ kapotakaḥ

tām evotsṛjya nāhāraiḥ
kāryyam asty aparair mmama 42
śyenāḥ kapotān_ khādaṃti śrutir eṣā sanātanī

sa rājan_ sāram ājñātvā kadalīskaṃdham ā
ruha 43
nāhaṃm uchāstravārgeṇa kvacid varte vihaṃgama
śāstrair epadṛṣṭo yaṃ dharmaḥ satvadayāparāḥ 44

sarvasatveṣu
yad dānam ekasatveṣu yā dayā
sarvasatvapradānāt tu dayaikasmiṃ viśiṣyate 45
sarvavedānu tat_ kuryu sarve yajñāś ca khecaraḥ
sarvatīrthābhiṣekās tu yaḥ kuryāt prāṇināṃ dayā 46
vāṃmanaḥkarmabhir yet tu sarvabhūtahite ratāḥ

dayādarśitapaṃthāno
brahmalokaṃ vrajaṃti te 47
gachaṃtaḥ tiṣṭato vāpi jāgrataḥ svapato pi vā

yaṃ na bhūtahitārthāya tatpasor iva ceṣṭi
taṃ 48
jaṃgamāni ca bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi ca ye narāḥ
ātmavatparirakṣaṃti te yāṃti paramāṃ gatiṃ 49

prāṇanāṃ vadhya
mānāṃ tu yaḥ śakṛchram upekṣyate
sa yāti narakaṃ ghoraṃm iti prāhur manīṣiṇaḥ 50

rājyaṃ śivānāṃ sumahat prayachāmi tava
dvija
yad vā kāmayase hy anyat_ varjjayitvā kapotakaṃ 51
yadi rājan_ kapote te sudṛḍhā bhaktir īdṛśī
tataḥ kapotatulyāni svamāṃsāni prayacha me 52
anugraham imaṃ manye yan māṃ syenobhijācase

eta te haṃ
prayachāmi svamāṃsaṃ yāvad ichasi 53
yadā priyāṃ ta svajanā cirād vadati vā na vā

mame tu priyam evaitu kasmād abhihi
taṃ cirāt 54
adhruveṇa śarīreṇa pratikṣaṇavināśikā
dhruvaṃ yo nārjayed dharmmaṃ sa socyo mūḍhacetanaḥ 55

yadi
prāṇam upakārāya deho yaṃ tāpayujyate
tataḥ kim upacāro sya pratyahaṃ kriyate vṛthā 56

nātirikta
m ahaṃ yāce tava māṃsan nareśvara
tasmāt kapotena samaṃ prayacha tulayā dhṛtaṃ 57

tad evāhaṃ kariṣyāmi yan māṃ sye
nābhiyācase
yenāsya rakṣaṇaṃ me syāt tad vadasva vihaṃgama 58

evam uktā svamāṃsāni samuchedya sa pā
rthivaḥ
prahṛṣṭas tolayāmāsa kapotena saha prabhuḥ 59
tyaktātmasukhabhogechāṃ sarvasatvamukhaiṣiṇaḥ

bhavaṃti paraduḥ
khena sādhavo nityaduḥkhitāḥ 60
dhṛyamāṇas tu tulayā kapoto vyatiricyate

punaś cotkṛtya māṃsāni rājan prādā
t sā pārthivaḥ 61
na vidyate yadā māṃsaṃ kapotena samaṃ kvacit_
tataḥ prakṣīṇamāṃso sāv āroha tulayā tataḥ 62

parasu
khāya svaṃ duḥkhaṃ sarvabhūtahite ratāḥ
nopekṣaṃte mahātmāno svaśarīre mahaty api 63

athātmānaṃ pīḍaṃyitvā sā
dhuḥ sukhayate paraṃ
hlādayitvā śriyān vṛkṣā sahaṃte cātapaṃ svayaṃ 64
atha tasmin samārūḍhe tulām auśīnare nṛpe

de
vaduṃdubharyor neduḥ puṣpavṛṣṭi papāta ha 65
tatas tasya tadā matvā devarājo dhṛtiṃ parāṃ

śakraḥ svarūpam āsthāya vākya
m etad abhāṣataḥ 66
idro ham asmi bhadraṃ te kapoto havyavāhanaḥ

jijñāsamānau rājaṃs tvām imaṃ yajñam upā
gatau 67
naitat pūrve nṛpāś cakrur na kariṣyaṃti cāpare
mahākāruṇikeneha yat kṛtaṃ duṣkaraṃ tvayā 68

parārthaikāṃtakadhi
yā svārthe cātyaṃtaniṣṭurāḥ
tvayy eva kevalā rājan karuṇākaruṇālaye 69

svakarmmapāsaiḥ sudṛḍhaṃ badhaṃ kṛtsnam idaṃ ja
gat ||
tvaṃ jagaduḥkhamokṣārthaṃ baddhaḥ karuṇayā nṛpa || 70 ||
yathā sarvārthatā vāpi deveṣu prākṛtaṃ tvayā |

tathā naivātmasaṃtrāṇāaṃ vā
sanāpi nideśatā || 71 ||
akṛterṣā vasiṣṇeṣu hīnānāṃ nāvamanyate |
āgatvā sadṛśe sparddhātvaṃ lokottamatāṃ gataḥ 72
paropakārajanmāno vidhāttrā vihitāś ca ye |
sajalā jaladās tvaṃ ca saphalāś ca mahādrumāḥ || 73 ||

ātmaprāṇaiḥ paraprā
ṇānyo naraḥ parirakṣati |
sa yāti paramaṃ dhāmayato nāvarttate punaḥ || 74 ||
prāṇair api tvayā rājan_ rakṣataḥ kṛpaṇo yataḥ ||

sva
māṃsany api dattāni dravyeṣṭv anyaṣu kā kathā || 75 ||
paśavo pi hi jīvaṃti kevalātmodaraṃbharāḥ

sa punar jīvitaślāghyo yaḥ
parārthe ha jīvati || 76 ||
kim atra citraṃ yat saṃtaḥ parānugratatparāḥ
na hi svadehaśītāya jāyaṃte caṃdanadrumāḥ || 77 ||

paropakā
ravyāpāre paro yaḥ puruṣaḥ sadā
svapadaṃ tad avāpnoti parād api hi yat paraṃ || 78 ||
paropakāraikaramā svasukhāgatasaspṛhā |
jagaddhitāya jāyaṃte sādhavas tv ādṛśā bhuvi | 79 ||
yat svamāṃsāni gātrebhyaḥ samuchitāni pārthiva ||

eṣa te śāśvatī kī
rtiḥ parād api hi yat paraṃ || 80 ||
devarūpadharaś caiva pālayatvaṃ ca medinīṃ ||

sarvalokān atikramye brahmalokaṃ gamiṣyasi ||
81 ||
evam uktā tam iṃdrāgnī jagmatus tridaśālayaṃ
rājā śata kratuṃ iṣṭvā mumude devavac citaraṃ || 82 ||

ya idaṃ
śṛṇuyān nityaṃ śiveś caritam adbhutaṃ ||
vidhuya sarvapāpāni prayāti tridivaṃ nara || 83 ||

viciṃtya rājā svasarīram adhruvaṃ ya
śaṣ karaṃḥ sarvajanasya durllabhaṃ
śarīradānāt parajīvarakṣaṇaṃ vidhāya lokatrayabhūṣaṇaṃ yayau 84

body.p:
iti śrī itihāsasamucca
ye śyenakapotīye caturtho dhyāyaḥ
